about: Answer test set for the five sample documents in eval/docs (a fictional company). Run: python scripts/eval_answers.py. Each case passes only if every 'expect' item is in the answer (a list means any one of them), the answer cites 'cite' (and 'page' if given), and nothing from 'must_not' appears. 'not_found': true means the answer must be exactly the not-found sentence. 'follow_up_of' gives the earlier case used as chat history.
